description: This source file defines the MultivaluedMapContextAdapter class, which implements the Map interface to provide a view of a multi-value map as a single-value map. It adapts a MultivaluedMapContext object to behave like a standard Map, allowing simplified access to the first value associated with each key.

classes.name: MultivaluedMapContextAdapter
classes.description: A Java class that adapts a MultivaluedMapContext to implement the Map interface, providing a simplified view where each key maps to a single value (the first value in the list).

methods.name: MultivaluedMapContextAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with the underlying MultivaluedMapContext object.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of keys in the underlying multivalued map.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the map has no keys.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the underlying map.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a value exists among the first values of each key in the map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the first value associated with the given key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates the specified value with the specified key, replacing the current value and returning the previous.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the mapping for a key and returns the associated value.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Puts all entries from another map into the adaptee, inserting each value with a single call.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all mappings from the underlying map.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a Set view of the keys contained in the map.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a Collection view of the first values in the map.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a Set of key-value pairs, each representing a map entry with the first value for each key.
